title: Mark Lifecycle
intent: Create and restyle specialized marks, then remove jitter, label layout, radius, or complete mark resources.
useWhen: Use this recipe when an existing chart needs focused mark appearance changes or complete graphical lifecycle cleanup.
avoidWhen: Avoid this recipe when field-driven appearance or position should be changed through an encoding instead.
prerequisites: Provide immutable row objects containing every field named by the selected actions and example program.
Use explicit public resource identifiers whenever current program state contains more than one compatible candidate.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: An array of plain row objects containing the fields required by this task.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Task-specific field names, resource identifiers, and supported visual or statistical choices.

outcomes: Create and restyle specialized marks, then remove jitter, label layout, radius, or complete mark resources.

steps.instruction: Prepare only the existing mark lifecycle state required by the selected focused operation.
Apply the primary action that produces the recognizable mark lifecycle result or workflow.
Choose only the focused mark lifecycle components required by the task; mutually exclusive creation alternatives are demonstrated as independent chart variants.
Use the focused lifecycle actions only after their owned mark lifecycle resources exist and are uniquely targeted.

alternatives.when: Choose a neighboring recipe when its stated result and data roles match the requested chart more directly.
alternatives.instruction: Prefer one complete domain facade or task recipe before composing lower-level actions manually.

pitfalls.problem: Implicit targeting fails when several compatible datasets, marks, scales, guides, or owners exist in the same program.
pitfalls.fix: Pass the exact public identifier named by the action signature instead of relying on first-resource selection.
